title: Prototype_1b peer freshness and ACIS lineage reconciliation
mode: Deeper/broader primary-source review and implementation-readiness refinement

localScope.head: de27a33
localScope.worktreeState: The repository already contained broad uncommitted changes. This pass changed only DWG_DXF_OPEN_SOURCE_PARITY_PLAN.md and this research receipt; no codec or test source was edited.

sources.sourcePin: Local copy reviewed; extracted §24.2.2.3-24.2.2.4 text directly with pdftotext on 2026-10-21.
sources.observation: The section defines the Object Data Alignment Offset as a 16-byte-unit offset from the data-segment start and describes data headers, local record offsets, inline records, and blob01 pages. It also contains prose for the data start marker and maximum record-size calculation. Peer discussion reports disagreement between that prose and observed offsets in some files.
sources.planDisposition: The repository's AGENTS.md names this local PDF authoritative. A peer interpretation does not supersede it. Before any local parseDwg/AcDs implementation change, read the exact relevant section and reconcile units, terms, and sample trace; record unresolved ambiguity rather than copying a competitor's formula.

sources.sourcePin: PR states and mutable master source as viewed 2026-10-21; no ACadSharp checkout, package, or executable was used.
sourceClaims: PR #1139 merged ACIS payload extraction for modeler geometry entities across DXF/DWG carrier variants.

PR #1154 merged a full low-level DWG Prototype_1b section reader on 2026-07-28, replacing the earlier DWG signature-scan path. The current source selects the segment index from the file header and computes the data start from ObjectDataAlignmentOffset shifted by four bits.

PR #1154 discussion reports a 423-file corpus differential. After isolating section-level reading and applying an offset correction, 3,715 common referenced handles had matching payload hashes. The discussion distinguishes raw section parse from entity attachment and records a stale-index overflow on a pre-merge candidate branch.
The current reader's section catch is conditional on configured failsafe mode; strict mode propagates the exception.
As viewed 2026-10-21, writer PRs #1150 and #1240 remained open; #1240 depended on #1174. These do not establish merged/released write support.
sources.disposition: Optional modern-DWG structural/carrier comparator only after exact release/commit admission. Keep storage-section parsing, data-entry extraction, handle-to-entity attachment, and semantic shape construction as distinct outcomes. Historical pre-merge failures are not asserted as current defects; exact released behavior remains unqualified until a pinned run.

sources.sourcePin: Current repository README/Cargo manifest/tests and historical 0.2.4 package documentation as viewed 2026-10-21; no package or executable was used.
sourceClaims: ACadRust is a separate Rust codec; project documentation describes ACadSharp as an inspiration rather than a runtime dependency.
Current ACadRust tests include same-codec R2018 DWG roundtrips and transport-only controls using synthetic SAB-shaped marker/filler bytes.
OpenCADStudio and CADCraft identify ACadRust as their DWG/DXF engine, so their parser observations share that codec route.
sources.disposition: Treat ACadRust as a distinct implementation with a correlated design lineage to ACadSharp. Count app-level observations separately from parser evidence, but do not count multiple ACadRust-backed applications as independent parser votes. Same-codec roundtrips and synthetic marker bytes do not establish semantic ACIS validity.

sources.sourcePin: Mutable documentation/repository pages as viewed 2026-10-21; no peer runtime was used.
sourceClaims: acis-core validates indexed reference closure but states that this does not establish B-rep validity.
The documented conversion route uses cq-acis/CadQuery with OpenCascade; this is not an independent geometry-kernel vote relative to FreeCAD Part.
sources.disposition: Optional bounded payload-to-shape route only, requiring complete body reachability, explicit unknown-record disposition, independently calculated expectations, and an already-closed outer carrier/owner mapping.

planChanges: Update the peer inventory: ACadSharp's full DWG Prototype_1b reader is merged; older wording that treated its DWG read path as merely proposed is historical. Do not transfer this to its unmerged writer proposals.

Require stage-separated denominators and comparisons for Prototype_1b section entries, referenced payload bytes, and entity-handle attachment; a mismatch at one layer does not identify another layer's defect.

At the composed peer checkpoint, pin a build containing #1139 and #1154, then use generated scratch-only modern DWG controls with varied owner order and data-record boundary counts; include strict/failsafe and stale-index disposition.
Keep ACadRust as a distinct implementation but correlated in design lineage to ACadSharp; group OpenCADStudio and CADCraft observations under the ACadRust codec route.
Retain acis-core/cq-acis as a bounded OCCT-family shape route rather than an independent kernel or native FreeCAD witness.
Keep immediate implementation self-unblocked: complete the local generated AC1015/AC1024 VIEWPORT frame/owner check before any optional peer execution.

existingOwners: PAR-07/S8 versioned ACIS carrier, association, semantics, and consumer evidence
PAR-144 optional composed structural peer checkpoint and local frame/owner verification

limitations: This was source/specification research only. Mutable repository pages were not pinned to a release for execution; no peer package, binary, native CAD application, test suite, or downloaded drawing was used. PR discussion is not a normative DWG rule. The ODA PDF remains authoritative for local DWG byte-layout decisions. No external sample or fixture was added.
